title: AVerMedia Live Gamer 4K 2.1 GC575 Capture Card, New

comparisons.notes: Same GC575 Live Gamer 4K 2.1, new, UPC 850036764366; page shows in stock

writeup: Woot has the AVerMedia Live Gamer 4K 2.1 (GC575) capture card new for $104.99. It is an internal PCIe capture card built for recording and streaming 4K gameplay with HDMI 2.1 passthrough. AVerMedia's own US store sells it for $209.99, so this Woot price is about 50% lower.
